summary: Enova International filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned indirect subsidiary OnDeck Asset Securitization IV, LLC issued $500,026,000 of Series 2026-1 Fixed Rate Asset Backed Notes on September 25, 2026, the sixth series under a 2023 base indenture with Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas as trustee. Proceeds purchased small business loans from OnDeck, collateralizing a roughly $526 million revolving pool. Four classes were rated by Kroll at a 6.22% weighted-average fixed coupon, with a September 2028 revolving period and October 2032 final maturity. This is a routine financing, not a special situation event.
